messages:
maria: Quick sync — aiming to schedule the design review for the new pagination API + SDK + Console UX. Looking for a 60m slot next week to walk the RFC, surface perf numbers, and run through the runbook checklist. TL;DR: need reviewers (API/SDK/UX), oncall sign-off, and pre-reads done by EOD Tue.

jorge: Wed 15:00 PST works for me. If we do Wed, can we make it 45m focused + 15m runbook/ops?

priya: Thu morning is slightly better for me but I can shift Wed. Recording + a short agenda doc would help. @maria can you add a Figma pointer?

maria: Yep — adding Figma + perf link in the pre-read. Proposed agenda in the doc: 1) quick RFC recap (10m) 2) API surface & SDK examples (15m) 3) Console UX walkthrough (10m) 4) perf/latency tradeoffs (10m) 5) runbook & rollouts (15m). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/reviews/pagination-runbook (pre-read).

ben: Quick heads-up — PR #1422 is the main change set. I asked for a small refactor in the SDK helper; current diff is here: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1422. Pls check the examples in the PR.

emily: I can be oncall for the runbook bit. Please ping me for the rollout window decision. Also will add the canary metrics to the doc.

priya: Pre-read checklist I'm going to follow: 
```
- Read RFC summary in doc (top section)
- Review PR #1422 code snippets and SDK examples
- Run local sample: repo/examples/pagination -> npm install && npm run start
- Run perf script: ./scripts/bench_pagination.sh --seq 256 --iters 50
- Check Console mocks in the Figma link (Comments on page 3)
- Look at rollback plan in runbook (section 4)
```

maria: Nice checklist — adding two small asks: @ben please add expected token cost numbers to the perf section; @emily can you confirm alert thresholds and doc the runbook alert IDs.

ben: Will add token cost table tonight. Also leaving inline note in PR about the SDK helper API.

runbook-bot: reminder: attach runbook to the calendar invite and include oncall alias in the invite description.

jorge: Who's taking notes / producing action items? I can capture notes if someone else runs the meeting.

maria: I'll run it and @jorge please capture notes. Can everyone mark availability in the Doodle poll (link in the doc) by EOD Mon? If majority picks Wed 15:00 PST, I'll send the calendar invite with the pre-read pinned.

priya: Marked. Also quick Q: are we expecting any DB migration during rollout? If so, need a migration playbook stub.

maria: No DB migration for this release — only config flags and a migration of local cached keys (handled client-side). I'll still add a short migration note in the runbook.

emily: LGTM on runbook outline. I'll add the alert IDs and canary thresholds tomorrow morning.

ben: ping me for SDK review after you add the token numbers. I'll try to ship the small refactor by Tue EOD.

maria: Great — thanks all. Final ask: reviewers, please finish pre-read by Tue EOD so we can keep the review crisp. :thumbsup:
